newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-BankAmerica EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BankAmerica EPS view raised.

text.p: Ryan Beck & Co said it increased 1997 and 1998 profit estimates for BankAmerica Corp on Friday, after it posted second quarter earnings of $1.07 a share, up 19 precent from $0.92 last year.
-- Analyst Lawrence Cohn raised 1997 EPS to $4.20 from $4.10 "reflecting the better than anticipated fee income growth." He also raised 1998 estimate to $4.60 from $4.55.

-- Kept bank's rating at hold, saying current results can probably continue uninterrupted and company has a good fundamental outlooks, but valuation is "relatively rich" and further multiple expansion relative to the group seems unlikely.
